name: 주사
note: cinnabar vermilion (朱砂); the red of suns and seals

name: 장단
note: red lead / minium (鉛丹); orange-red; was #D8634F (red lead is orange-red, L~45-50; the MMCA 장단색 #D8634F is a lighter coral (dE 18))

name: 석간주
note: iron-oxide red (石間硃); trunks and grounds

name: 연지
note: rouge from safflower (臙脂); pinks of flowers; was #DE6D8B (rouge lake as a pigment is crimson L~45; #DE6D8B was the thin-wash pink)

name: 육색
note: flesh tint: jangdan + white

name: 황토
note: yellow ochre (黃土)

name: 자황
note: orpiment (雌黃); bright yellow; was #ECCA56 (orpiment is golden (b*~68, a*~+10), not lemon)

name: 치자
note: gardenia yellow (梔子); glazes

name: 석청
note: azurite (石靑); deep blue of peaks and skies

name: 삼청
note: azurite lightened with white (三靑); pigment-swatch value since the MMCA 삼청색 #6B7ABB leans violet

name: 군청
note: ultramarine (群靑) synthetic since the 19th c.; pigment-swatch value since the MMCA 군청색 #555790 is a greyed violet-blue; was #2B3F8C (natural ultramarine a*~2-8, not the violet-leaning a*19)

name: 석록
note: malachite (石綠); greens of peaks and leaves; was #3F8A5B (ground malachite is a soft grey-green, L~60 a~-25; #3F8A5B was too dark and saturated (dE 17))

name: 하엽
note: lotus-leaf dark green (荷葉)

name: 뇌록
note: celadonite grey-green (磊綠); grounds; was #5E7355 (celadonite measures a* near 0 (보존과학회지 2008/2015), greyer than #5E7355)

name: 양록
note: emerald/Paris green (洋綠); 19th c. import; was #50BA6E (emerald/Paris green L~50-58; #50BA6E was too light)

name: 자색
note: purple from rouge over indigo

name: 호분
note: oyster-shell white (胡粉)

name: 먹
note: ink (墨)

name: 홍
note: safflower red (紅花) on silk

name: 쪽
note: indigo (藍) on silk

name: 자초
note: gromwell purple (紫草) on silk

name: 치자염
note: gardenia yellow on silk; was #F2D569 (gardenia on silk gives a rich gold, not pale lemon)

name: 괴화
note: pagoda-tree green-yellow (槐花) with indigo

name: 소목
note: sappanwood red-brown (蘇木)

name: 연홍
note: light safflower pink on silk (연분홍)

name: 옥색
note: light indigo on silk; jade

name: 송화
note: pine-pollen yellow on silk

name: 소색
note: undyed silk (素色); the fibre itself

name: 현
note: black silk (玄)

name: 연분
note: lead white (鉛粉); the white of 17th-19th c. paintings

name: 회청
note: smalt (回靑); the blue that replaced azurite from the 18th c.; was #4A6FA5 (smalt is a deep violet-blue, L~24-28; #4A6FA5 was a mid blue (dE 25))

name: 밀타승
note: litharge yellow (密陀僧)

name: 등황
note: gamboge (藤黃); organic yellow glaze

name: 금
note: gold leaf and gold paint (金); accents in decorative paintings

name: 양청
note: Prussian blue (洋靑); late 19th c. import

name: 분홍
note: pink, 장단 + 호분 (장단육색); the 초빛 of the red 빛 ladder

name: 백록
note: pale green, 양록 + 호분 (삼록); the 초빛 of the green 빛 ladder

name: 분삼청
note: pale blue, 삼청 + 호분; the 초빛 of the blue 빛 ladder

name: 주홍
note: vermilion red (朱紅); dancheong name for the cinnabar step

name: 다자
note: dark brown-red, 석간주 + 먹; the deep step of the red 빛 ladder
